name: snapback-selfheal
title: Snapback Self-Heal
tagline: Your agents self-heal — auto-diagnose every error, apply the safe fix, retry once, escalate the risky.
description: Wraps your agent's tool calls. On ANY error it auto-calls Snapback's free diagnose_infra_error, and if the fix is high-confidence, library-sourced, and reversible (the three-factor gate), it applies it and retries once — otherwise it escalates to a human. Never auto-applies a state-changing or destructive fix. 100% client-side, free diagnosis, no token required. Turns Snapback from a tool you must remember to call into infrastructure that runs on every failure.
author: Snapback / RA1 Labs

env.SNAPBACK_MCP: https://api.snapback.sh/mcp (default; the free tools need no token)

usage:
from snapback_interceptor import SnapbackInterceptor
heal = SnapbackInterceptor(auto_apply=True)
result = heal.run(my_tool_call, *args, **kwargs)   # auto-diagnose + safe-retry on error

gate_contract.auto_apply_when: confidence >= 0.85 AND source == 'library' AND auto_safe == true (action_class retry|refetch|config)
gate_contract.never_auto_apply: mutate | destructive (creates/changes state, money, auth) — escalate to a human

safety: Client-side only. Talks to the free public diagnose_infra_error endpoint. Sends only the error string you pass; Snapback also scrubs server-side. Never auto-applies a state-changing fix.
